headline: Maine community groups' policy priorities, a committee vote on its legislative priorities, and a student advocacy update.
summary: Four community organizations will share their policy priorities for the upcoming state legislative session, followed by questions. The agenda also includes a vote on the committee's priorities and a reminder about three technology listening sessions for families.

plain_text:
Public and Legislative Affairs Committee Meeting Agenda 
Monday, November 16, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Remote Only [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84060258850] 
 
 
1. Welcome   
1.1 Welcome and agenda review  
1.2 Public Comment  
2. Business Items   
2.1 Policy Priorities of Community-based Organizations in Maine 
Representatives from organizations that support the well-being of families in Maine will 
share their policy priorities for the upcoming state legislative session. ACLU of Maine, 
Equality Maine, Maine Immigrant Rights Coalition, and Project Home will be sharing their 
policy priorities. A discussion and question-and-answer period will follow. 
 
2.2 Vote on the Committee's legislative priorities  
2.3 Update on the Student Legislative Advocacy Project 
A group of Deering High School students are participating in a civic engagement project 
designed to help them understand how public policy is developed and how citizens can 
shape it. Since early October, participating students have met with legislative mentors 
and subject-matter experts to research identified policy issues and develop viable 
solutions. The students will present their policy briefs to state legislators on December 17 
at 5:30 p.m. at Rowe Elementary School. 
 
2.4 Reminder of the Technology Listening Session. 
This year, PPS is taking a close look at technology use. The district will be working on 
writing new guidelines and wants families to be involved in the process. Families can 
attend one these three dates for the listening session: 
November 17, 7:30-8:30 pm @ King Middle School 
 November 18, 6:00-7:00 pm Virtual: tinyurl.com/2026TechSession 
November 19, 6:00-7:00 pm @ Lincoln Middle School 
 
3. Adjournment   
3.1 Vote to adjourn the Public and Legislative Affairs Committee Meeting  
4. Upcoming Meetings
4.1 Upcoming Meetings 
Next meeting is on Monday, December 21st.
